capabilities: Export the active note as PDF or .typ source
Build a cover page from YAML frontmatter keys
Generate a numbered table of contents and revision/approval tables
Render callouts, checkboxes, tables, math, Mermaid and Excalidraw
Export bundles with images for later command-line conversion
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux). PDF export needs Typst installed; without it only .typ source export works. PDF embeds need Typst 0.14 or newer. Bundle export requires the separate omd2typst command line tool. The plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian's own PDF output has no cover page, numbered table of contents, revision and approval tables, or custom document templates.

relations.evidence: using Typst, a modern document compiler
Rendered with the Excalidraw plugin (light theme, white background) to a PNG (default) or SVG image

summary: Exports notes to typeset PDFs or Typst source through the Typst compiler, adding a cover page, numbered table of contents and revision tables.
